RUCKING REVOLUTION | EVENT PREPARATION

Event / date: ______________________
Official organiser link: ___________
Distance / time limit / elevation: _
Mandatory load and equipment: ______
Entry conditions and support: ______

Work backwards from the event
[ ] Record a recent repeatable session (time, distance, load, terrain).
[ ] Identify the largest gap between that session and the event.
[ ] Build a weekly plan with easier days and recovery.
[ ] Practise the actual footwear, pack and food.
[ ] Rehearse climbs or other specific demands where relevant.
[ ] Check how training feels and adjust rather than forcing a deadline.
[ ] Reconfirm event rules and travel before booking.
[ ] Plan food, rest and transport after the event.

Next session: ______________________
What to review: ____________________

This worksheet is for planning, not a prediction of readiness or a prescription.
